description: CORRECTED DIAGNOSIS (two spikes at HEAD 47903558b; supersedes both the original settle-race framing AND the 'closure-arrow' framing). FINDINGS: (1) The closure slot is ALREADY convergence-folded to an address var (a2) by convergence_class_at's callable branch -- it is NOT the fragmentation axis. (2) The all?/any? sibling ActivationKeys of reduce_while_cont/3 differ ONLY on input[1] = the ACCUMULATOR LITERAL (the reduce seed): :false (any?), :true (all?), :false|:true (recursive union). The acc is a scalar/atom-literal slot that falls through convergence_class_at's enumerated shapes to the catch-all *a and stays verbatim in the key -> one sibling per literal. Same CLASS as the (now-closed) partition/4 list-emptiness over-spec, different type constructor. (3) BUT folding the acc is the WRONG fix (prototyped, commit 4e6d83b65 on wt/spike-xqw-frag -- DO NOT PROMOTE): folding collapses the siblings 3->2 but the demand crash does NOT go away -- it MUTATES from 'ValueId(6) must be runtime-materializable' (acc Nothing) to a native-codegen closure-target conflict (driver.rs:961 'direct closure target cannot receive 2 call args through 1 logical params' / driver.rs:940 capture_count 1 [RawAtom] != capture_count 0 []), AND regresses transport_plan_preserves_nested_enum_reduce_predicate_capture_shape. ROOT: folding merges into ONE shared body reduce_while_cont that is then invoked with closures of DISTINCT capture surfaces (all?/2,any?/2 capture  -> [RawAtom]; all?/1,any?/1 capture nothing -> []); build_codegen_closure_targets asserts one capture surface per FnId; the single-target sibling reaches a DIRECT closure-call edge it cannot reconcile because fz-k22.1's boxed CallEdge::Indirect only fires for targets.len()>1. So closure capture surface is PER-CALL EVIDENCE that must NOT be folded -- this is the SpecKey/BodyKey per-call-evidence split (analogous to fz-f98.14.10 splitting convergence-identity from transport-LAYOUT-identity; (K) needs convergence-identity split from codegen closure-CAPTURE-identity). TWO CANDIDATE FIXES: (a) route the closure call through the boxed indirect edge (CallEdge::Indirect/generic_callable_shape) whenever the SHARED BODY is reached by 2+ distinct capture surfaces across siblings -- decide on the BODY's aggregate capture-surface multiplicity, not the callsite's local targets.len(); generalizes fz-k22.1; loci materialize_closure_call_edge + arg_demands_for_summary (both gate on local targets.len()>1) + native build_codegen_closure_targets; needs a new fact (body's aggregate capture-surface multiplicity); ~80-150 LoC. (b) keep siblings distinct (no fold) and fix the acc-Nothing demand directly at native.rs:3127 (smaller, targeted; leaves over-spec in place) -- NOTE this connects to clause-0 (base case returning acc) being pruned as unreachable at the [int] (non-[]) specialization. Related: fz-k22, fz-k22.1, fz-f98.14.10.
title: fz-k22: shared HOF body reached by 2+ distinct closure CAPTURE surfaces -- the crash is per-call closure-capture evidence, NOT a settle-race or a convergence fold
